about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client, an established business specialising in beautiful interiors and home furnishings, for an enthusiastic and experienced Showroom Sales & Administration Assistant to join its team in Msida, Malta.

The role combines customer-facing showroom sales with the administration that keeps every order moving. You will welcome visitors to the showroom, advise them on furniture, fabrics, wallpapers, lighting and home accessories, and help them put together product selections, colour schemes and furnishing combinations. Behind the scenes you will prepare quotations and invoices, process orders, coordinate deliveries and follow up with suppliers and customers so that each purchase runs smoothly from first enquiry to delivery.

This full-time, on-site position suits someone with previous sales experience, ideally in interiors, furniture or furnishings, who has a genuine passion for interior design and a natural eye for aesthetics. The package is €2,000–€2,300 per month plus percentage-based commission on sales, a company laptop and mobile phone, and 28 days of annual leave. Working hours are Monday to Friday with occasional Saturday work, and the expected start is ideally by the end of the year or in January.

faq: What does a Showroom Sales & Administration Assistant do?

You welcome showroom customers and advise them on furniture, fabrics, wallpapers, lighting and home accessories, then handle the administration behind each sale: quotations, invoices, order processing, delivery coordination and follow-up with suppliers and customers.
What is the salary for this job in Msida?
The role pays €2,000–€2,300 per month depending on experience, plus percentage-based commission on sales. A company laptop and mobile phone and 28 days of annual leave are also included.

Previous sales experience is required, preferably within interiors, furniture, furnishings or a related industry, along with strong administrative skills and confidence in preparing quotations, invoices and managing orders.
This is a full-time, on-site position working Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturday work.
Do I need a driving licence?
Yes. A valid driving licence is one of the requirements for this role.
